description: This file defines a Blazor component partial class for a Catalog Items listing page in an admin interface. It handles data retrieval, component interactions for CRUD operations, and UI state management.

classes.name: List
classes.description: A Blazor component class managing catalog item data display and CRUD operation interactions.

methods.name: OnAfterRenderAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to load catalog data after initial rendering and refreshes the UI.

methods.name: DetailsClick
methods.description: Handles the action to view details of a catalog item.

methods.name: CreateClick
methods.description: Handles the action to initiate creation of a new catalog item.

methods.name: EditClick
methods.description: Handles the action to edit an existing catalog item.

methods.name: DeleteClick
methods.description: Handles the action to delete a catalog item.

methods.name: ReloadCatalogItems
methods.description: Reloads the list of catalog items and updates the UI.
